messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads up — several interviewers report they can no longer view PDF attachments linked to scorecards after this morning's permissions sweep. Happened on two panels so far.
Jules (Hiring Ops): Which panels / candidate ids? any contractor interviewers involved?
Ravi (Recruiter): Panel IDs 314 and 319. One of the interviewers was a contractor (Sam), they specifically said the attachment link returns 403. I forwarded the candidate zip to Slack.
Ava (People Ops): Yep contractor included. Quick triage: seems tied to the recent ACL migration we ran at 09:10. Not sure if it's presigned URL perms or an app-level visibility flag. :eyes:
Marco (Eng): Can you paste the failing URL (sanitized) and a curl output? Also which auth header the UI is sending?
Ravi (Recruiter): FWIW the UI shows the attachment, but clicking -> 403. Here's the URL (redacted): https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/attachments/abc123.pdf
Ravi (Recruiter): curl -I returns: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Priya (Eng-Platform): ATS sync job ran at 09:10 and did an ACL reconcile. Our job log shows ~1.6k ACL row updates. I'm pulling the job diff now.
ATS Bot: ACL-sync-job-2026-03-23T09:10:00 completed. rows_changed=1623, errors=0.
Marco (Eng): If the S3 presigned URLs are still valid but S3 returns 403, likely the object-level ACL or bucket policy denies GET for the IAM role used by presigner. Priya — can you check the presign role's policy and whether the migration temporarily flipped object owner?
Priya (Eng-Platform): Looking. Quick find: the migration script set object-owner-to-uploader=true for legacy objects and then reapplied bucket-policy. There's a bug in the reapply step that overwrites the presign role condition. Reproduced locally.
Ava (People Ops): Ok. Impact is interviewers can't access attachments during interviews — bad. Priority: hotfix.
Marco (Eng): Proposed hotfix: revert ACL-change for attachments prefix and re-run presigner-policy apply with the correct condition. Rollback plan: run a targeted reverse-migration for prefix /attachments/ with a dry-run, then apply. ETA ~30-45m if no surprises.
Jules (Hiring Ops): Can we hotpatch only contractor-related panels first? we need to restore access to upcoming interviews in next hour.
Priya (Eng-Platform): We can do targeted revert for keys referenced in panels 314 and 319. I need the exact object keys; Ravi can paste them.
Ravi (Recruiter): Pasted the two keys in the DM. Confirmed they match the ones in the UI.
Marco (Eng): I'll queue the revert. Running dry-run now. Command snippet:
```
./acl-migrate --env prod --prefix attachments/panel-314 --revert --dry-run
```
Marco (Eng): Dry-run shows mismatch fixed for those two objects. Proceeding to full revert and presigner policy reapply.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Reapply step will also rotate a presign token for a short window. We'll signal the UI to refresh links.
ATS Bot: ACL-sync job rollback initiated by Marco at 2498765560.
Ava (People Ops): Please ping hiring managers and impacted interviewers after rollback. I'll draft a short note.
Marco (Eng): Revert done for targeted keys, presigner policy reapplied. Verified curl -I now returns 200 for those two objects.
Ravi (Recruiter): Confirmed Sam and panelists can open the PDFs now. Thank you! :raised_hands:
Priya (Eng-Platform): Scheduling a broader rollback of the problematic migration window at 09:10 if cross-checks pass. Will post a runbook snippet when done.
Jules (Hiring Ops): Could we add a pre-migration smoke test next time that checks a sample of contractor access? This would have caught it.
Ava (People Ops): Agreed. Action items: 1) Priya/Marco to run broader rollback and post runbook 2) Marco to open a changelog PR that adds a post-migration smoke test 3) I will notify affected candidates/PMs and update the incident tracker.
Marco (Eng): Opening PR now.
Priya (Eng-Platform): Broader rollback scheduled in 20m if no other regressions.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks team. Notifying stakeholders now.
Jules (Hiring Ops): Adding a note to interviewer handbook about 'if attachment 403, DM recruiter and ping #people-ops' as interim guidance.
Ava (People Ops): Will follow up with a retro tomorrow. :calendar:
